text:
erin: FYI hit a weird auth issue during a demos-with-sampleapp session. Rotated a project key but containerized sample still used the old key and returned 401s.

vik: did you rotate the key in the dashboard or via the CLI? and where did you set the new value?

erin: rotated in the dashboard, updated compose override with REDWOOD_API_KEY, rebuilt image. Container logs show resolver picked up a creds file inside the image: `/home/app/.redwood/creds` with an old token. I thought env var should take precedence.

cli-bot: quick check: Docker build can bake files into the image. If your Dockerfile copied `~/.redwood` into the image at build time you'll have stale creds. We should add a sampleapp lint rule to fail builds that copy home dir.

qa-sam: repro steps I used: 1) docker build with old creds present 2) rotate key in dashboard 3) update docker-compose env, `docker compose up --build` 4) container still uses old creds baked in image.

vik: this is two separate DX problems: a) precedence inconsistency across SDKs (env vs disk vs in-memory cache) and b) sampleapp & Docker examples accidentally encouraging bad patterns (copying local creds).

erin: workaround for demo: removed the creds file from image and restarted with env-only. But that's not obvious in onboarding docs.

docs-zoe: action: sweep sampleapps, quickstarts, and Dockerfiles to ensure NONE copy `~/.redwood`. Replace with `--build-arg` or use env_file and secrets. Add an explicit sentence in README: "Do not copy your local ~/.redwood into built images."

vik: technical fix plan: 1) make all SDKs unify precedence to: env var (REDWOOD_API_KEY) > creds file (~/.redwood/creds) > in-memory cache. 2) resolvers must re-check env each request and clear cached token if env differs. 3) log a masked startup warning if env and creds file both exist and differ, showing last 4 chars. 4) deprecate alternate env names (REDWOOD_TOKEN) with clear migration warnings in v2 minor.

qa-sam: tests: add unit tests for env-only, file-only, file-then-env (rotation while running), and env-then-file. Also add an integration Docker test: build image with no creds, run container with env, then mount a stale creds file and assert container still prefers env.

cli-bot: filed issue redwood/sdk-cred#901 with repro steps and suggested fixes; tagged @eng-runtime and @devex.

erin: small UX ask: CLI when writing creds to disk should print a conspicuous warning if `~/.redwood` appears to be part of a git ignored build context or if `COPY ~/.redwood` is detected in Dockerfile (heuristic). Might prevent accidental baking of tokens.

docs-zoe: will add a "Safe Docker" subsection to onboarding: show `ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY=${REDWOOD_API_KEY}` in compose or use `--env-file` with CI secrets. Also include a troubleshooting checklist for rotation: unset alternate envs, remove stale creds, restart containers.

vik: timeline: patch SDKs to env-first + cache invalidation in next minor (v1.10.0), docs update same week, add Docker lint/GHA job in sampleapp repo to catch COPY of home creds.

erin: filed a small PR to sampleapp README with the docker caveat and a one-liner troubleshooting snippet.

qa-sam: will add the Docker integration test to CI and run a canary on staging.

cli-bot: Reminder: link PRs to redwood/sdk-cred#901 and ping @security for review of logging (we mask tokens).

erin: resolved for demo with workaround (remove creds, use env) but logging this to prevent future pain. Thanks all.
